name: Downloads Snapshot Responsiveness
changes: Bounds live Downloads Queue/History access to the serialized private-SAB transport so legitimate long-running control operations cannot make /api/downloads and diagnostics wait behind the control lock indefinitely.

Returns the last coherent presentation snapshot immediately to concurrent API callers while another snapshot build is in flight, with explicit stale-presentation markers and snapshot timing telemetry.

Uses short single-attempt budgets only for live presentation Queue/History reads while preserving the stronger existing retry/reconciliation behavior for authoritative non-live recovery and queue mutation paths.
Makes SAB transport telemetry observational instead of taking the control lock and adds transport wait/busy and snapshot build/lock telemetry for future diagnostics.
Recognizes Inno Setup's canonical unins000.exe as an installed runtime marker while retaining the legacy Uninstall.exe compatibility marker.
regression_guards: The v3.6.20+ serialized SAB transport remains intact; v3.6.41 bounds only live presentation wait time and does not reintroduce overlapping localhost SAB control requests.
Stale presentation snapshots never drive tombstone cleanup, duplicate cleanup, Pause recovery, queue ownership, terminal-state reconciliation, Automation admission, or Smart Import decisions.
Non-live authoritative Queue/History refreshes and mutation/recovery paths retain their existing retry budgets and semantics.
v3.6.40 runtime-storage cleanup, v3.6.39 startup-reservation refinement, and v3.6.38 crash-recovery/queue-admission protections remain unchanged.
Manual Search/Grab, Newznab behavior, no-downgrade protection, Downloads continuity, Automation scheduling, installer upgrade behavior, and user-data locations are unchanged.
